unit.why: Short anecdote about the Neshkhiz rebbe relying on the Bach for kiddush levanah on Sukkot. Inside it he tells a narrative about the Besht's dream concerning the Bach's ruling on new grain (chadash).

stories.start_quote: פ״א עשה מרן מנסכיז זלה״ה מעשה
stories.end_quote: כדאי הב״ח שמתיר כדי לסמוך עליו
stories.summary_en: The Neshkhiz rebbe relied on the Bach and sanctified the moon during the meal on the second night of Sukkot. He told how the Besht asked in a dream about the law of new grain and was told that Gehinnom had been cooled for forty days in the Bach's honour, so the Besht drank beer made from new grain, relying on the Bach.
